verdict.rationale: The hybrid deployment doc states that scanner execution, S3 storage, and AI inference all run inside the customer's own AWS account, implying data can stay within a customer-controlled region, but Gecko never documents an explicit region/residency selection mechanism or SaaS-side data locality options. Missing for 10: explicit region-selection UI/setting, documented list of supported regions, and confirmation that the SaaS-hosted dashboard/database also offers residency choice.
